Every control and format code point has one disposition, read by the sanitizer and the width measure (rich-control-codes-xh4n.xt7) (#533)

* Every control and format code point has one disposition, read by the sanitizer and the width measure (rich-control-codes-xh4n.xt7)

* The sanitizer's disposition check is exhaustive, and a clean string costs one match (rich-control-codes-xh4n.xt7)

The measure's switch bound a new Disposition and the sanitizer's filter did not, so a variant that moved ESC out of `strip` compiled and reached the wire. Both readers now refuse to compile until they say what the variant does.

The clean check is `match` rather than `test`: `test` coerces, so a template's unlifted scope value read as "[object Object]" and rendered as success instead of failing as a template error.

The reverse census accepts Cn, so a row for a newer Unicode's code point passes on every Node `engines` admits.

* The width table names the clause it holds, and the strip test asserts the width (rich-control-codes-xh4n.xt7)
